Before that, he was six-term Congressman from the state of Indiana and Governor of the same state from 2013 to 2017. He is the thoughtful and principled leader who has had a distinguished career in public service. It's an honor to welcome former Vice President Mike Pence to the American idea. Thank you for joining us, sir.
